title: Dog Night, 2022
logline: Twenty-three years. The alley, the dumpster, a back, the pup, rain. The sign above nearly dark. No caption. The bird on the dumpster's lid, which the page doesn't remark.

panels.composition: The alley behind the Lanes at night in rain: the dumpster, a man from behind in a rain shell, a small three-legged dog beside his boot, the sign above with nearly every tube dark — and on the dumpster's lid, the rainbow bird, sitting in the rain, unremarked.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a rain-dark alley behind a bowling alley with a dumpster, a man seen from behind in a rain shell with a small three-legged dog at his boot, a neon sign above with nearly all letters dark, and a small rainbow bird sitting on the dumpster's lid, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: Uncaptioned. The bird on the dumpster.
